task_description: Build TrustMark - a PWA web app on Google Apps Script for adding timemark/timestamp overlays to photos with EXIF metadata manipulation, map-based location selection, QRIS payment integration, and professional overlay rendering. All client-side processing with localStorage persistence.

verification.summary: All files validated: Code.gs has proper GAS functions (doGet, include, HtmlService), manifest.json is valid JSON with PWA fields, sw.js has install/fetch/activate handlers with CDN caching, index.html (51.6KB) contains all required modules (piexif, leaflet, qrcode, Canvas, QRIS, Nominatim, EXIF, timemark overlay, payment) with valid JavaScript syntax and proper HTML structure.
